hook: A massive 4.4 billion dollar Alaska energy deal was just announced by Donald Trump!

sections.voiceover: A massive 4.4 billion dollar Alaska energy deal was just announced by Donald Trump!
b_roll: Map showing Alaska connected to Taiwan through a pipeline

sections.voiceover: Taiwan's CPC Corporation agreed to buy 30 percent of the proposed Alaska LNG project output. CPC Corporation plans to buy 6 million metric tons annually. Are these 20-year energy supply contracts actually signed and sealed yet?
Taiwan's Economic Affairs Ministry states binding agreements aren't finalized yet.
CPC Corporation could invest up to 4.4 billion dollars in the project.
That 20-year energy timeline shapes future geography.
b_roll: Globe centering on the Pacific Rim
